normative_statement: A budget or gate waiver MUST specify budget_id, reason, evidence_links, operator, created_at, and expires_at. Expired waivers automatically re-block the release gate. A waived budget CANNOT authorize its user-facing claim copy.

rules.no_expired_waivers: Any waiver with expires_at in the past is status=expired and re-blocks its target budget/gate.
rules.claim_copy_suppression: Any budget with an active waiver must suppress corresponding claim copy in docs/README.
rules.max_duration_enforced: No waiver can be created with duration exceeding max_waiver_duration_days (30 days).
